scope: Part06f existing custody migration only; no new source/acceptance conclusions; no sixth-group or Linux completion claim.

checks.source_and_archive: all size/SHA256/mode and regular type; full archive SHA256/size/Git-blob checked
checks.tar: exact ordered member set and manifest bytes; safe unique paths, no links/extras; zero padding/tail; all raw header/PAX bytes match source stat metadata
checks.actual_custody_maps: queue-bound original index/progress bytes independently read, all file references checked, manifest ELF descriptors cross-checked
checks.ELF: streamed single gzip CRC/EOF; original and compressed SHA/size, ELF64 x86_64 header; exact physical coverage; before/verified/after receipt identities bound
checks.source_index_scope: source-index path/SHA references checked across immutable map/before/manifest; referenced external source indices not opened outside allowed custody roots
checks.metadata: small metadata may already be Git-covered; retained for self-contained recovery and not counted as added ELF
